# `surfaces/WebGPUSurface.js`

> **Source:** `engine/surfaces/WebGPUSurface.js`

engine/surfaces/WebGPUSurface.js — a surface source that ADOPTS an externally rendered GPU texture instead of uploading pixels from a canvas. The host renders into its own render target(s) and hands the current texture/view to the surface each frame via `adopt()`; SurfaceManager then exposes it like any other surface (sampleable on a mesh) with zero copies. This backs feedback/mirror effects and "stream the screen onto a screen" use-cases (SURFACE_SOURCE.WEBGPU).  Safety: it only ever adopts textures the host already owns — there is no capture of arbitrary external content.

## Functions

### `createWebGPUSurface(opts = {})`

**Parameters:**

- `opts` *(object)* — { width, height, texture?, view? }

**Returns:** an external surface source
